_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/EidolonGantry/tools/make_shape.py. The gantry, its winch and chains were made for the Seraph Horizons mod. The elements named b_<stage>_<name> are the eidolon's body and those named sp_<name> its spine, the gantry's (Anego Studios' model, Vintage Story's mobile eidolon; see CREDITS.md), posed in the eidolon's 'hung' animation and baked into static boxes, the body's renamed by build stage. Keep element names when editing: the rig finds its parts by them.
